description: Tables W7, W8, W9, W15, W16 and W17 hold 7, 8, 9, 15, 16 and 17 LONG columns c1..cN. Each gets three rows: all columns set, only the last column set, and every column but the last set. The rows are read back and the closed file is kept, so null-mask boundaries at multiples of eight are in one image.
retentionNote: Designed r-def-cat-txn probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
